name: NestJS / TypeORM / Next.js / React Native
description: Enterprise cross-platform stack: NestJS 11 + TypeORM backend (cookie sessions with SHA-256-hashed opaque tokens, scrypt-in-worker password hashing, config-driven login throttle with 429 + Retry-After, documents CRUD, fixed-catalog algorithm workbench with a tighten-only engine bound) implemented and tested (vitest + supertest on a REAL better-sqlite3 in-memory database, 54 tests, plus a 32-check real-HTTP smoke); Next.js 15 App Router web client on a shared API-client layer implemented, production-built and tested (8 screen tests); shared envelope/ApiClient layer tested (12 tests); React Native (Expo) shell authored over the same shared layer but UNVERIFIED (no mobile SDK).
